title: Disappearance of Monica Reza near Mount Waterman
place_text: Mount Waterman, San Gabriel Mountains, Angeles National Forest, California

tellings.quote: So, let's go back to June 22nd, 2025, when the woman who taught us how to tame fire vanished.

plain: A podcast host named Jesse Michels tells of Monica Reza, whom he calls 'the woman who taught us how to tame fire', and says she vanished on June 22nd, 2025, near Mount Waterman in the mountains of the Angeles National Forest outside Los Angeles. He mentions the Los Angeles County Sheriff's Department in connection with the case. He tells it in an episode about American scientists who have gone missing, suggesting her case may be part of a larger pattern.
